description: This file defines a custom matcher function 'toHaveURLWithPredicate' for Playwright testing, which waits for a page URL to match a predicate, and a helper function 'toHaveURLMessage' for generating failure messages.

methods.name: toHaveURLWithPredicate
methods.description: Asynchronously waits for a page URL to satisfy a predicate, with optional case ignoring and timeout.

methods.name: toHaveURLMessage
methods.description: Generates a detailed message for URL matcher failures, including expected and received URL details.
